zh.title: 中國國航C919執飛烏蘭巴托 完成首個國際客運航班
zh.summary: 中國國航C919客機由北京飛抵烏蘭巴托，完成該機型首次非國內客運航班。
body: 中國國際航空於2026年8月12日以國產C919-100(ER)客機，執行從北京首都國際機場（PEK）飛往烏蘭巴托新國際機場（UBN）的航班。該架註冊號為B-919Y的客機於當地時間15:20前起飛，並於17:00左右降落，完成C919機型的首次非國內客運航班。
在此之前，國航在該條每日往返蒙古首都的航線上主要部署波音737 MAX 8客機。自2022年首架C919交付中國東方航空以來，該機型過去僅在中國國內航線營運。據ch-aviation數據，中國商飛至今已交付不到40架C919，客戶包含國航、東航與南航。

en.title: Air China COMAC C919 Completes First International Flight to Ulaanbaatar
en.summary: Air China operates its COMAC C919 from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar on its first international flight.
body: On August 12, 2026, an Air China COMAC C919-100(ER), registered B-919Y, completed the aircraft model's first international passenger flight. The aircraft departed Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) shortly before 15:20 and arrived at Ulaanbaatar New International Airport (UBN) in Mongolia at around 17:00 local time.

Air China previously operated a Boeing 737 MAX 8 on this daily route to Ulaanbaatar. Since the C919 was first delivered to China Eastern Airlines in 2022, the narrowbody jet had only flown on domestic routes within China. According to ch-aviation, COMAC has delivered fewer than 40 C919 aircraft to date, with current airline operators including Air China, China Eastern Airlines, and China Southern Airlines.

zh.title: 西班牙伊比利航空A321XLR於萬呎高空直播日全食
zh.summary: 伊比利航空安排A321XLR客機於高空透過Starlink網路直播日全食。
body: 西班牙伊比利航空（Iberia）安排空中巴士（Airbus）A321XLR 客機執行一項特別飛行任務，預計於 33,000 呎高空飛行，並實況直播當天出現的日全食景觀。
根據航空新聞 Simple Flying 報導，伊比利航空針對該架 A321XLR 客機規劃了特別航線，選定於西班牙帕倫西亞（Palencia）上空進行飛行觀測。
為了在萬呎高空傳輸即時畫面，該架 A321XLR 客機配備高速 Starlink 衛星網路技術，向全球實況播送高空視角的日全食過程。

en.title: Iberia Uses Airbus A321XLR To Livestream Total Solar Eclipse Over Palencia
en.summary: Iberia operates an Airbus A321XLR at 33,000 feet to livestream the total solar eclipse using Starlink.
body: Spanish flag carrier Iberia is operating a specially routed Airbus A321XLR aircraft at an altitude of 33,000 feet to provide a livestream of today's total solar eclipse.
According to coverage by Simple Flying, the airline has configured the A321XLR flight path specifically over Palencia to capture and broadcast the total eclipse event from high altitude.
To transmit the video stream live from 33,000 feet during the flight operation, the Airbus A321XLR is equipped with ultra-fast Starlink satellite internet connectivity.
The unique flight operation allows viewers to follow the solar eclipse in real time through Iberia's broadcast stream, powered by Starlink technology over Palencia.
